name: Cannibal
ability: You have the ability of the recently killed executee. If they are evil, you are poisoned until a good player dies by execution.
wakes: When the gained ability would wake, at that character's night order.
interaction: Not told which ability was gained. After an evil executee, poisoned and woken as the character the evil player claimed, to fake an ability.
drunk_or_poisoned: The gained ability malfunctions. After an evil executee the Cannibal is poisoned until a good player dies by execution, which also gives them that player's ability.

jinxes.text: If the Cannibal gains the Butler ability, the Cannibal learns this.
If the Juggler guesses on their first day and dies by execution, tonight the living Cannibal learns how many guesses the Juggler got correct.

rulings.text: Each new execution death replaces the previous ability; executing a dead player, or one who survives, gives nothing.
Abilities that work while dead (e.g. Recluse, Ravenkeeper, Sweetheart) are kept after the Cannibal dies.
An executed Mutant gives an ability that never wakes, so the Cannibal learns nothing.
Night order numbers are from the bra1n townsquare roles.json; 0 there is recorded as null.

test_scenarios.name: gains-clockmaker
test_scenarios.setup: Cannibal; Clockmaker executed and dies day 1; Imp and Poisoner two steps apart.

test_scenarios.name: evil-executee
test_scenarios.setup: Widow bluffing Fortune Teller executed and dies day 1; Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Cannibal woken to pick two players and picks the Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: The Cannibal is poisoned; the Storyteller may answer no.

test_scenarios.name: poison-cleared
test_scenarios.setup: Cannibal poisoned from an evil executee; day 2 the Empath is executed and dies.
test_scenarios.expected: Poison is removed; the Cannibal has the Empath ability and gets true info.

test_scenarios.name: survivor-no-gain
test_scenarios.setup: Cannibal has the Chef ability; day 2 a player protected by the Tea Lady is executed and survives.
test_scenarios.expected: The Cannibal keeps the Chef ability; gains nothing.

test_scenarios.name: butler-jinx
test_scenarios.expected: The Cannibal is told they have the Butler ability.
